figurative_meaning_en: to bring under control or bewitch
similar_in_english: to have someone under one's thumb
example_sentences_in_bangla: সেই চালাক মেয়েটি ছেলেটাকে ওষুধ করে ফেলেছে।
উসকানি দিয়ে সে তার স্বামীকে ওষুধ করেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: That cunning girl has bewitched the boy.
She has put her husband under her spell with her charms.
note: Idiom often implies using charm or trickery to dominate someone, rooted in folk beliefs about potions.
